gaps.explanation: Schedule is 33,394 above the statement (12,419,453 vs 12,386,059). The budgetary comparison schedules count sale of surplus inside 'Local' receipts; the governmental funds statement (p5) prints it under Other Financing Sources as 'Sale of surplus' General Fund 29,154 + Road Fund 4,240 = 33,394 (Total column 33,394, p6). General Fund budget schedule p10 Local 1,347,433 = statement/combining Local 1,318,279 (p5, p7) + 29,154; Road Fund budget schedule p11 Local 1,233,488 = statement Local 1,229,248 (p5) + 4,240. 29,154 + 4,240 = 33,394 = the gap. Both totals are printed (statement Total receipts 12,386,059 p6; General budget 7,404,000 p10; Road budget 2,937,877 p11); no detail fix.
